title: C6-3X Districts
previewText: In C6-3X Districts in Excluded Areas, the underlying regulations shall apply except that the maximum residential floor area ratio shall be 7.5 for zoning lots containing standard residences, or 9.0 for zoning lots containing qualifying affordable housing or qualifying senior housing.
